name: Aaron Russell
title: Director, Network Infrastructure
brief: As Global Director of Edge Network Infrastructure at Meta, Aaron leads a global engineering organization responsible for advancing Meta's edge infrastructure strategy.
bio: As Global Director of Edge Network Infrastructure at Meta, Aaron leads a global engineering organization responsible for advancing Meta's edge infrastructure strategy. His work focuses on extending GPU compute and caching closer to users through Meta's Edge Cloud and content delivery network PoPs, enhancing performance and minimizing latency for Meta's family of apps, A.I., and Reality Labs content. His work enabled Meta to deliver billions of videos and photos efficiently across its platforms to users, along with supporting the training of Meta's open weights models across its network infrastructure stack.

name: Adam Holton
title: Chief People Officer
brief: Adam Holton is Chief People Officer at GE HealthCare, leading the company’s global HR strategy and team.
bio: Adam Holton is Chief People Officer at GE HealthCare, leading the company’s global HR strategy and team. He brings more than 20 years of HR leadership experience across public and private organizations. Before joining GE HealthCare, Adam served as Chief People Officer at Amedisys and held Chief Human Resources Officer roles at Numotion and CHS, Inc., as well as HR leadership positions with USAA and Bank One. A U.S. Naval Academy graduate, Adam is a Marine Corps veteran and serves on the board of Sierra Delta, a nonprofit supporting veterans through service dog training and educational resources.

name: Adrian Groos
title: CEO
brief: Adrian Groos is the co-founder and CEO of Nimbus Aerospace, an investor-backed aerospace company building next-generation hybrid-electric business aircraft.
bio: Adrian Groos is the co-founder and CEO of Nimbus Aerospace, an investor-backed aerospace company building next-generation hybrid-electric business aircraft. The company combines advanced manufacturing with proprietary, AI-driven certification software developed in-house. Nimbus is backed by Techstars and advised by leaders from SpaceX, Boeing, and the Federal Aviation Administration. Adrian leads a multidisciplinary team of engineers and operators with experience at organizations including Raytheon, Bombardier, and Microsoft. Prior to co-founding Nimbus Aerospace, he worked in product management roles at SoLo Funds and Platform Science.

name: Akim Niyonzima
title: Chief Technology Officer
brief: Akim Niyonzima is the co-founder and CTO of Nimbus Aerospace, an investor-backed aerospace company developing next-generation hybrid-electric business aircraft.
bio: Akim Niyonzima is the co-founder and CTO of Nimbus Aerospace, an investor-backed aerospace company developing next-generation hybrid-electric business aircraft. The company integrates advanced manufacturing with proprietary, AI-driven certification software built in-house. Nimbus is backed by Techstars and advised by leaders from SpaceX, Boeing, and the Federal Aviation Administration. Akim leads a team of engineers with experience at organizations including Raytheon and Microsoft. Prior to co-founding Nimbus Aerospace, he worked in avionics and operations at Bombardier.

name: Albaner C. Eugene Jr.
title: Founder and President of ACE Productions and Let’s Move, and author of Momentum
brief: Albaner C. Eugene Jr. is the founder and president of the media company ACE Productions and Let’s Move, a nonprofit organization dedicated to fostering connection, healing, and meaningful community.
bio: Albaner C. Eugene Jr. is the founder and president of the media company ACE Productions and Let’s Move, a nonprofit organization dedicated to fostering connection, healing, and meaningful community. His career as a filmmaker began in 2009 and he uses his background as a creative director, ordained minister and mental health professional to encourage people in their personal transformation. His debut book Momentum released on October 13th.

name: Alex Allen
title: Director,  Social Impact & Inclusion
brief: Alex Allen is Global Head of Inclusion and Engagement at Cisco, where he leads global strategies that strengthen inclusive organizational culture, employee engagement, and lasting trust.
bio: Alex Allen is Global Head of Inclusion and Engagement at Cisco, where he leads global strategies that strengthen inclusive organizational culture, employee engagement, and lasting trust. A highly respected human capital strategist, he has earned three North American Employee Engagement Awards and a Bronze Stevie Award and was twice named among Inspiring Workplaces’ Top 101 global influencers. His leadership experience spans BroadSoft, Under Armour, Nestlé, The Home Depot, and GE. Alex holds bachelor’s and master’s degrees in Human Resource Management from Wilmington University and completed Wharton’s Chief Human Resources Officer program.

name: Alexa Turnage
title: Co-Founder
brief: Alexa Turnage is the Co-Founder of Black Tech Saturdays, pioneering a groundbreaking movement to empower underrepresented communities within the tech industry.
bio:
Alexa Turnage is the Co-Founder of Black Tech Saturdays, pioneering a groundbreaking movement to empower underrepresented communities within the tech industry.

Alexa’s passion for technology and equality and Johnnie’s grassroots activism and entrepreneurial spirit culminate in a powerful force for change. Together, they spearhead initiatives that offer educational workshops, mentorship programs, and networking events, creating pathways for aspiring Black professionals. Their collaborative efforts exemplify a commitment to breaking down barriers and creating a more diverse and equitable tech ecosystem.

name: Alexis Cureton
title: E2 Fellow; Clean Energy Consultant
brief: Alexis Cureton is an E2 Fellow and clean energy advocate advancing equitable access to sustainable infrastructure, environmental justice, and economic opportunity.
bio: Alexis Cureton is an E2 Fellow and clean energy advocate advancing equitable access to sustainable infrastructure, environmental justice, and economic opportunity. Previously, he held roles at Microsoft, the Natural Resources Defense Council, and the Greenlining Institute, advocating for policies that improve health outcomes and expand clean energy access for low-income communities. Born in Tulsa, Oklahoma, home of Black Wall Street, and raised between Atlanta and Indianapolis, Alexis holds a bachelor's degree in Sociology from Clark Atlanta University and a master's degree in Energy and Policy Analysis from Indiana University.

name: Alexis Cureton
title: E2 Fellow, Principal Community Partnerships and Grants Consultant
brief: Alexis Cureton is an E2 Fellow and clean energy advocate advancing equitable access to sustainable infrastructure, environmental justice, and economic opportunity.
bio: Alexis Cureton is an E2 Fellow and clean energy advocate advancing equitable access to sustainable infrastructure, environmental justice, and economic opportunity. Previously, he held roles at Microsoft, the Natural Resources Defense Council, and the Greenlining Institute, advocating for policies that improve health outcomes and expand clean energy access for low-income communities. Born in Tulsa, Oklahoma, home of Black Wall Street, and raised between Atlanta and Indianapolis, Alexis holds a bachelor's degree in Sociology from Clark Atlanta University and a master's degree in Energy and Policy Analysis from Indiana University.

name: Alexis Johnson
title: Head of Social Impact - Beats by Dre
brief: Alexis N. Johnson is a PR professional with 12+ years in sports, media and entertainment. As PR lead and head of social impact at Beats, she leads consumer communications and developed Beats Academy.
bio: Alexis N. Johnson is a PR professional with 12+ years in sports, media and entertainment. As PR lead and head of social impact at Beats, she leads consumer communications and developed Beats Academy. A 2025 NABJ Patricia L. Tobin Media Professional Award winner and PRNews In-House Innovator, Johnson previously worked at the NFL and pioneered Complex’s PR team as the first publicist for "Hot Ones." She is a proud Mizzou graduate and Alpha Kappa Alpha Sorority, Inc. member based in Los Angeles.

name: Alonzo Weatherby
title: Senior Manager, Mid Market
brief: A Sr Manager, Mid Market, for Intuit Enterprise Suite.
bio: A Sr Manager, Mid Market, for Intuit Enterprise Suite. A proud Morehouse College graduate, he brings 20+ years of sales, marketing, partnership, and leadership experience across Building Materials, Mobility, Financial Technology, Sports Marketing, and Buy Now Pay Later. He has been both the individual contributor grinding for the number and the leader building the team that hits it. He has built high-performing teams, grown partnerships that moved revenue, and championed talent development. A former Business Manager/Chief of Staff for NBA All-Star Isaiah Thomas, Alonzo believes relationships close deals, but culture closes careers.

name: Alyssa Wisdom
title: Director of Analytics
brief: Alyssa Wisdom leads data science and analytics for DoorDash's Core Consumer experience, a team of roughly 20 people owning the surfaces millions of people use to discover, search, and order, and one…
bio:
Alyssa Wisdom leads data science and analytics for DoorDash's Core Consumer experience, a team of roughly 20 people owning the surfaces millions of people use to discover, search, and order, and one that drives roughly $XB in incremental Gross Order Value.

Her work sits at the intersection of AI, experimentation, and decision-making at scale. Lately that has meant putting large language models into production and building a causal platform that estimates, for any customer, what a particular action is actually worth to the business. The throughline across all of it: turning ambiguous questions into measurable signals that change what we build.

name: Andrew Yang
title: Entrepreneur, Bestselling Author & Co-Founder
brief: ANDREW YANG, Entrepreneur, Bestselling Author & Co-Founder, Forward Party
bio:
ANDREW YANG, Entrepreneur, Bestselling Author & Co-Founder, Forward Party

Andrew Yang is a serial entrepreneur who was a Democratic presidential candidate in 2020. He is co-founder and CEO of Noble Mobile and co-founder of the Forward Party, an independent political movement dedicated to restoring the promise of American democracy. He previously founded Humanity Forward and Venture for America. His New York Times bestseller The War on Normal People helped bring universal basic income into the mainstream, and his latest book, Hey Yang, Where’s My Thousand Bucks?, is a collection of stories and reflections from his life in the public eye.

name: Anthony Kerr
title: Senior Product Marketing Manager
brief: Anthony Kerr is a Senior Product Marketing Manager on the Microsoft Copilot marketing team, where he leads product marketing for Copilot’s productivity experiences.
bio: Anthony Kerr is a Senior Product Marketing Manager on the Microsoft Copilot marketing team, where he leads product marketing for Copilot’s productivity experiences. An alumnus of North Carolina A&T State University, he is passionate about building community and is the founder of The Collective Seattle, the largest social community for young professionals of color in Seattle. In recognition of his professional achievements and community impact, he was named a 2024 40 Under 40 honoree by the Puget Sound Business Journal.

name: Anwar White
title: Dating Coach and Author
brief: Anwar White (aka the Fairy Godbrother) is a dating and relationship coach based in Montreal, Canada.
bio: Anwar White (aka the Fairy Godbrother) is a dating and relationship coach based in Montreal, Canada. He is the CEO and founder of Get Your Guy Coaching, a program dedicated to helping Black and Brown women date strategically, heal their hearts, and enter the best relationships of their lives. With over 1.5 million followers across platforms, Anwar combines psychological insight with practical strategies to empower women in their dating lives. His insights and weekly viral videos have been featured in ABC News, CNBC, The New York Times, Business Insider, The Washington Post, BuzzFeed, BBC, Yahoo News, and Essence.

name: Araine Greer
title: SR. Cloud Solution Architect Engineering Data & AI
brief: Araine Greer, known as FashionTECHDiva, did not follow a traditional path into technology,she built one!
bio: Araine Greer, known as FashionTECHDiva, did not follow a traditional path into technology,she built one! After motherhood ended the fashion career she once dreamed of, she started over, learned to code using SQL Server, earned a Microsoft certification, and transformed a leap of faith into a 13-year career in tech. Today, as a Senior Cloud Solution Architect at Microsoft, she helps organizations design cloud, data, and AI solutions while inspiring and mentoring others. Her story challenges people to view disruption differently: to pivot with purpose, embrace lifelong learning, and believe that new beginnings can lead to extraordinary success.

name: Arian Simone
title: Author & Founder, Fearless Fund
brief: Arian Simone is an Ivorian Queen, venture capitalist, entrepreneur, philanthropist, and author whose life reflects fearless leadership and impact.
bio: Arian Simone is an Ivorian Queen, venture capitalist, entrepreneur, philanthropist, and author whose life reflects fearless leadership and impact. As Founder and CEO of the Fearless Fund, the first venture capital fund built by women of color for women of color, she has secured backing from institutions like J.P. Morgan Chase and Bank of America to invest in diverse founders. Today, as Queen Wa of Dawa Grand Bereby in Côte d'Ivoire, she partners with the Ivorian government to empower under-resourced communities and advance sustainable development.

name: Arielle Clay Poteau
title: Host & Content Creator
brief: Arielle Clay Poteau is a host, content creator and former television news reporter with more than 15 years of experience in media.
bio: Arielle Clay Poteau is a host, content creator and former television news reporter with more than 15 years of experience in media. Her career has spanned broadcast journalism, digital media and branded storytelling, including editorial leadership at Blavity. Today, she works in commercial acting and creates lifestyle content, bringing the curiosity of a journalist to everything she does. Arielle lives in Atlanta with her husband and their 3-year-old son.

name: Arif Gursel
title: Managing Director
brief: Arif Gursel is a creative and technical executive who effortlessly transitions between left- and right-brain executions, demonstrating adaptability and versatility.
bio: Arif Gursel is a creative and technical executive who effortlessly transitions between left- and right-brain executions, demonstrating adaptability and versatility. He is currently the founder and managing director of 8genC (pronounced 'agency') Inc., a firm helping creators, brands, and technology companies scale through strategic leadership. Gursel'has held multiple global leadership roles at Fortune 500 companies, including Microsoft, Zillow, Salesforce, Netflix, and Google, where he specializes in technology, partnerships, and the creator economy. He invests in early-stage startups through Unified Capital and 8genC Venture Studios (8VS).

name: Arlan Hamilton
title: Author and Founder
brief: Arlan Hamilton is a serial entrepreneur, investor, author, and culture-shifter.
bio: Arlan Hamilton is a serial entrepreneur, investor, author, and culture-shifter. She is the Founder of Backstage Capital, a groundbreaking venture capital firm that has invested in 200+ startups led by underestimated founders. She is also co-founder of functional beverage company Gem Blends and the women’s professional basketball league 3XBA, and creator of Your First Million LIVE. Arlan is the author of four books, including It’s About Damn Time and Your First Million, and has been featured on the covers of Fast Company and Black Enterprise magazines.

name: Ashley Allison
title: CEO and Founder
brief: Ashley Allison is a political strategist, media executive, and national commentator shaping conversation on race, policy, and power in America.
bio: Ashley Allison is a political strategist, media executive, and national commentator shaping conversation on race, policy, and power in America. She is owner and publisher of The Root and founder and CEO of Watering Hole Media, leading culturally grounded journalism on democracy and culture. A regular CNN voice with two decades of experience, she served in the Obama White House and as National Coalitions Director for the Biden-Harris 2020 campaign, leading nearly 300 staff to build the most diverse voter coalition in modern political history, driving record turnout among Black, Latino, Asian American, Pacific Islander and Indigenous voters.

name: Ashley D. Farmer
title: Author
brief: Ashley D. Farmer is an award-winning writer, researcher, and cultural analyst who explores Black history and its implications today.
bio: Ashley D. Farmer is an award-winning writer, researcher, and cultural analyst who explores Black history and its implications today. Her first book, Remaking Black Power, was shortlisted for numerous prizes. Her second book, Queen Mother: Black Nationalism, Reparations, and the Untold Story of Audley Moore was a finalist for the National Book Critics Circle Award and won the 2026 Stone Book Prize. Farmer’s ideas and insights have appeared in multiple venues including Harper's Bazaar, NPR, The Washington Post, and Teen Vogue. Farmer lives, reads, and writes in Austin, Texas, and is an associate professor at the University of Texas at Austin.

name: Awah Teh
title: VP, Software Engineering
brief: Awah Teh is a seasoned tech executive and entrepreneur with experience in FinTech, media, and healthcare.
bio:
Awah Teh is a seasoned tech executive and entrepreneur with experience in FinTech, media, and healthcare. Known for leveraging data to build insights-driven cultures, Awah previously served as Global Chief Data Architect at Verizon Media Group, leading its cloud data strategy, governance, privacy, and enterprise data ecosystems.

Now CTO & Head of Data Platforms for Capital One Auto Finance, Awah oversees core data platforms. He also serves on the board of MIT’s CSAIL, influencing the Future of Data Initiative and Trace Data Sharing Protocol.

name: Benjamin Bennett
title: Executive Director - ISG Operations and Transformation
brief: Ben Bennett is a global business executive with 27+ years of experience in finance, operations, and transformation at Lenovo and IBM.
bio: Ben Bennett is a global business executive with 27+ years of experience in finance, operations, and transformation at Lenovo and IBM. As Executive Director of Operations & Transformation for Lenovo’s $15B+ Infrastructure Solutions Group (ISG), he leads operational excellence, digital transformation, and strategic initiatives that drive growth, efficiency, and business performance. Ben is recognized for turning strategy into execution and delivering measurable results through high-performing teams and cross-functional collaboration. He holds an MBA and a B.S. in Finance from Jackson State University.

name: Brandon William Jones
title: Founder & CEO
brief: Brandon William Jones is Founder and CEO of Gravy Wealth, a modern wealth-building platform helping professionals move from income generation to ownership.
bio:
Brandon William Jones is Founder and CEO of Gravy Wealth, a modern wealth-building platform helping professionals move from income generation to ownership. An experienced technology executive, investor, and board director, he has held leadership roles at ServiceNow, LinkedIn, and Google.

His work focuses on expanding pathways to wealth creation, particularly in underrepresented communities. He serves on the boards of SCAN Group and the SCAN Foundation, supporting governance, finance, and impact investing.

A Howard University alumnus, Brandon holds a BA in Computer Systems from Howard and an MBA from Harvard Business School.

name: Brandon Z. Hoff
title: Chief AI Officer
brief: Brandon Z. Hoff is a researcher, educator, and technology strategist helping organizations navigate the rapidly changing world of artificial intelligence.
bio:
Brandon Z. Hoff is a researcher, educator, and technology strategist helping organizations navigate the rapidly changing world of artificial intelligence. He is the founder of RUDI – Responsible Use of Digital Intelligence, a public education initiative that brings AI literacy and ethics into schools, communities, and boardrooms.

Hoff’s work bridges innovation and practice from designing AI-powered financial tools for healthcare providers to creating professional development programs for educators and policy leaders. He has advised universities, school districts, and legislators on responsible adoption of AI, while also building real-world systems that streamline decision-making and expand access to opportunity.

A frequent speaker and workshop leader, Hoff has been featured by several media publications for his human-centered approach to technology. His philosophy is simple: technology should solve human problems, not create new ones. Whether teaching, building, or consulting, he focuses on ensuring AI empowers people, strengthens communities, and drives meaningful progress.

name: Breana Jones
title: Principal Product Manager
brief: Breana Jones is a Principal Product Manager at Ancestry, where she leads Storytelling experiences that help people discover, understand, and preserve their family history.
bio: Breana Jones is a Principal Product Manager at Ancestry, where she leads Storytelling experiences that help people discover, understand, and preserve their family history. With more than a decade of experience at the intersection of storytelling and technology, she has built products at ESPN's Andscape, FiveThirtyEight, Medium, and VICE. A journalist by training, Breana holds a Bachelor of Journalism from the University of Missouri and a Master's degree from New York University.

name: Brian Tippens
title: Senior Vice President and Chief Social Impact & Sustainability Officer
brief: Brian Tippens is Senior Vice President and Chief Social Impact & Sustainability Officer at Cisco.
bio: Brian Tippens is Senior Vice President and Chief Social Impact & Sustainability Officer at Cisco. In this role, Brian leads the company’s integrated social impact and sustainability work, overseeing crisis response, accessibility, employee community impact, environmental sustainability, inclusion and the Cisco Foundation, to advance Cisco’s purpose to Power an Inclusive Future for All. He helps drive long-term value for Cisco, its stakeholders, and communities around the world by connecting social impact, resilience and sustainability across the business.

name: Brittini Abiolu
title: Program Manager
brief: For nearly 20 years, Brittni has worked at the intersection of founders, capital, and platforms.
bio:
For nearly 20 years, Brittni has worked at the intersection of founders, capital, and platforms. She has supported more than 120 early-stage founders and helped 64 companies raise a combined $4.5 million at the earliest stages of capital.

Brittni particularly enjoys working with overlooked and underrepresented technology founders of pre-seed and seed-stage companies that have strong execution potential and are ready for the discipline, strategic positioning, and credible pathways for investment.

name: Brooklyn Williams
title: Chief of Administration
brief: Brooklyn D. Williams is an executive leader, media producer, entrepreneur, and speaker whose
bio:
Brooklyn D. Williams is an executive leader, media producer, entrepreneur, and speaker whose

work bridges leadership, storytelling, faith, and community impact. She serves as Chief of

Administration at Antioch Missionary Baptist Church, Executive Director of John R. Adolph

Ministries, and Executive Producer of Ambassador Television. Through 2023 Vision LLP, she

brings brands and stories to life through visual media. A doctoral student in Leadership,

Brooklyn is passionate about developing emerging leaders, amplifying meaningful

conversations, and creating opportunities for the next generation.

name: Bryce Badger
title: Manager, Technology Strategy
brief: Bryce is a consultant in the strategy platform at PwC. In his role, Bryce focuses on enterprise architecture, software & product innovation, program management, and Digital & AI Strategy.
bio:
Bryce is a consultant in the strategy platform at PwC. In his role, Bryce focuses on enterprise architecture, software & product innovation, program management, and Digital & AI Strategy. He has relevant work experience in the U.S., China, Japan, Ethiopia, U.K., India, Norway, and Spain across Financial Services, Private Equity, and TMT sectors.

In addition to his client work, Bryce currently leads the New York Metro Shine LGBTQ employee resource group at PwC. Outside of work, Bryce can be found at language classes, riding at SoulCycle, or taking his dogs to the dog park.

name: Cameron Wadley
title: SVP; Supervision Technology Executive
brief: Cameron Wadley is the Supervision Technology Executive for the Wealth Management business and is responsible for the advanced platforms that monitor brokerage, investment, and trust activity to…
bio: Cameron Wadley is the Supervision Technology Executive for the Wealth Management business and is responsible for the advanced platforms that monitor brokerage, investment, and trust activity to ensure compliance with supervision guidelines. His organization delivers transformative solutions that focus on high-risk scenarios, trade activity, and suitability in support of Merrill, Consumer Investments, and the Private Bank. Cameron also leads the Global Technology chapter of the Black Professional Group and is one of Bank of America’s top inventors with 60+ patents filed and 40+ granted.

name: Candice Biamby
title: Vice President, Product Manager of Cyber Threat Intelligence
brief: Candice Biamby is the Vice President of Cyber Threat Intelligence at JPMorgan Chase, building enterprise-level security frameworks and advising on threat intelligence.
bio:
Candice Biamby is the Vice President of Cyber Threat Intelligence at JPMorgan Chase, building enterprise-level security frameworks and advising on threat intelligence. Her career spans hands-on technical work, regulatory compliance, and client-facing advisory roles at industry leaders like CrowdStrike and EY, backed by certifications from GIAC, AWS, and CrowdStrike.

Candice’s passion extends beyond the technical, committing to creating pathways for underrepresented voices in tech. She’s led community-driven initiatives to help students discover careers in cybersecurity and partnered with nonprofit organizations making education accessible.

name: Candice Coletrane
title: Executive Director - ISG Product Release Operations
brief: Candice is currently the Executive Director for Lenovo ISG Product Operations, where she leads a global team of 120+ responsible for launching enterprise infrastructure offerings that generated $15B…
bio:
Candice is currently the Executive Director for Lenovo ISG Product Operations, where she leads a global team of 120+ responsible for launching enterprise infrastructure offerings that generated $15B in revenue last fiscal year.

Candice is extremely passionate about her role in design and delivery of Lenovo AI Servers, and finds gratitude that her work directly supports Lenovo’s vision of “Smarter AI for All.”

With a background spanning operations, supply chain, and hardware development engineering, Candice is also a recognized Lenovo Master Inventor with 18 patents filed with the USPTO.

Candice has a MSCE (NCSU) and BSEE (NC A&T SU).

name: Candice Scarborough
title: Sr. Director, National Security Operations, Analytics & Engineering
brief: Candice Scarborough-Sanchez is a Senior Technical Director at Parsons Corporation, where she leads advanced cybersecurity, analytics, and engineering initiatives supporting national security missions.
bio: Candice Scarborough-Sanchez is a Senior Technical Director at Parsons Corporation, where she leads advanced cybersecurity, analytics, and engineering initiatives supporting national security missions. With over 20 years of experience in software engineering, cyber defense, and system architecture, she has led high-performing technical teams conducting vulnerability assessments and resilience engineering across critical defense and infrastructure systems. Beyond her role, Candice is the CEO of CNSible Solutions and host of the Glitch Grind Glow podcast, where she empowers tech professionals, founders, and underrepresented communities.

name: Captain Nia Gilliam
title: Author
brief: Captain Nia Gilliam is an accomplished airline pilot with over twenty-five years of experience.
bio: Captain Nia Gilliam is an accomplished airline pilot with over twenty-five years of experience. A trailblazer in aviation, she co-founded Sisters of the Skies, a nonprofit dedicated to increasing Black female pilots. Her contributions have earned her numerous prestigious awards and media recognition. And her story has captured the attention of major media such as CBS News, the Essence Disruptors Series, and Marie Claire. A Chicago native now living in Houston, she is a breast cancer survivor, champion for representation in aviation, and proud mother of two.

name: Caroline De Marco
title: Community Impact Ambassador, Population Health Center of Excellence, Genentech
brief: Caroline De Marco is an award-winning senior executive with over 30 years of leadership experience in the pharmaceutical and biotech industries.
bio: Caroline De Marco is an award-winning senior executive with over 30 years of leadership experience in the pharmaceutical and biotech industries. Currently, she is Genentech’s Community Impact Ambassador in the Population Health Center of Excellence. In this role, Caroline is responsible for developing and strengthening strategic partnerships and building trust and credibility with historically underserved populations to close care gaps and improve access to Genentech’s current and future portfolio. Her extensive experience spans sales, managed care, finance, people and culture, marketing, and talent management.

name: Carrol Chang
title: CEO
brief: Carrol Chang is the Chief Executive Officer of Andela, where she has led the company's evolution to a frontier data and services firm that enables enterprise organizations to adopt and deliver AI at…
bio:
Carrol Chang is the Chief Executive Officer of Andela, where she has led the company's evolution to a frontier data and services firm that enables enterprise organizations to adopt and deliver AI at scale. She is a leading voice on how AI is reshaping software engineering, transforming both workflows and the workforce, and the reskilling necessary to compete. She is driven by Andela’s founding mission to connect brilliance with opportunity.

Carrol has held positions with Uber, McKinsey & Company, Portraits of Hope, and the administration of President Barack Obama. She holds a BA from Harvard and both a JD and MBA from Northwestern University.

name: Chantel Greene
title: Chief of Tribal Relations, UnityCloud; Founder and CEO, Xexus Greene Energy
brief: Chantel Greene, a Nez Perce Tribal member, is Chief of Tribal Relations at UnityCloud, Founder and CEO of Xexus Greene Energy, and President of Sidney Resource Corporation.
bio: Chantel Greene, a Nez Perce Tribal member, is Chief of Tribal Relations at UnityCloud, Founder and CEO of Xexus Greene Energy, and President of Sidney Resource Corporation. She served as Vice-Chairwoman of the Nez Perce Tribal Council (2018–2021). A GRID Alternatives Tribal Energy Innovators Fellow, she completed the Tribe’s solar and storage resiliency project featuring Idaho’s first Tribal Tesla Megapacks, with service learning and workforce development for Tribal members. She holds a Master of Legal Studies in Indigenous Peoples Law from the University of Oklahoma

name: Chauncéa Carothers
title: Author, Brand Strategist, and Next-Generation Leadership Advisor
brief: Chauncéa is a sought-after entrepreneur, speaker and mentor who activates and equips influential and emerging leaders globally.
bio: Chauncéa is a sought-after entrepreneur, speaker and mentor who activates and equips influential and emerging leaders globally. She is also an accomplished content creator, minister, and award-winning brand strategist whose work has been featured in publications such as Forbes, Refinery29, and BuzzFeed.

name: Cheryl Contee
title: Co-Founder
company: BrightWorks AI and Change Agent AI
brief: Cheryl Contee is the Chief Innovation Officer and Co-Founder at BrightWorksAI.com. She is a pioneering technology entrepreneur and digital transformation expert.
bio: Cheryl Contee is the Chief Innovation Officer and Co-Founder at BrightWorksAI.com. She is a pioneering technology entrepreneur and digital transformation expert. She inspires audiences globally as a leading voice on inclusive entrepreneurship and social enterprise. She has co-authored a bestselling new book called "AI for Nonprofits: Putting Artificial Intelligence to Work for Your Cause" with Darian Rodriguez Heyman sharing insights from over 50 AI experts intended to help nonprofit leaders embrace new tech. She is also a senior advisor for PosterChild.AI and co-founder of Change Agent AI, mission-driven & gamechanging AI powered startups.

name: Chris Lyons
title: President a16z Halo
brief: Christopher Lyons is a visionary leader, entrepreneur, and President of a16z Halo at Andreessen Horowitz. Lyons joined a16z in 2013 and in 2021, he helped launch a16z’s first $400M Seed Fund.
bio: Christopher Lyons is a visionary leader, entrepreneur, and President of a16z Halo at Andreessen Horowitz. Lyons joined a16z in 2013 and in 2021, he helped launch a16z’s first $400M Seed Fund. Prior, he founded the firm’s Cultural Leadership Fund. Launched in 2018, CLF became a beacon of change, connecting the world’s greatest cultural leaders with cutting-edge technology companies. It became a platform to uplift Black builders and creators, fostering their journey toward excellence in tech. Under Lyons, the CLF Fund became Silicon Valley’s inaugural venture capital fund comprised entirely of Black Limited Partners.

name: Chris Smellie
title: Director of Product Marketing for Copilot Frontier
brief: Chris Smellie is the Director of Product Marketing for Copilot Frontier at Microsoft, where he leads go-to-market strategy for the company’s latest AI innovations.
bio: Chris Smellie is the Director of Product Marketing for Copilot Frontier at Microsoft, where he leads go-to-market strategy for the company’s latest AI innovations. Across two stints, Chris has spent more than a decade at Microsoft building and launching products at the intersection of technology, work, and culture. Previously, Chris worked at Meta, where he helped launch Ray-Ban Meta AI Glasses, bringing one of the first mainstream AI wearables to market. Outside of his day job, Chris writes Corporate Sidehustler, a newsletter exploring career, technology, and building a life beyond the corporate title.

name: Christelle Mombo-Zigah
title: Global Strategy and Planning in AI Infrastructure
brief: Christelle Mombo-Zigah is a futurist and problem-solver who believes technology should work for everyone, not just 20% of the world.
bio: Christelle Mombo-Zigah is a futurist and problem-solver who believes technology should work for everyone, not just 20% of the world. Born in France to Congolese parents and now based in Silicon Valley, she leads Global Strategy and Planning in AI Infrastructure at Cisco and is CEO and co-founder of StyleMyCrown. Her work in responsible AI has earned her a MIPAD Top 100 Futurist of African Descent honor and a spot among the San Francisco Business Times' Most Influential Women in Bay Area Business.

name: Christian Menefee
title: Texas’s 18th Congressional District
brief: Christian Menefee represents Texas’s 18th Congressional District in the U.S. House of Representatives, taking office in February 2026.
bio: Christian Menefee represents Texas’s 18th Congressional District in the U.S. House of Representatives, taking office in February 2026. A Houston native raised by two military parents, he became the youngest and first Black Harris County Attorney in 2020. He was the first in his family to graduate college, attending the University of Texas at San Antonio and Washington University School of Law. His career spans commercial litigation, pro bono advocacy, and public service, including defending voting rights, challenging pollution in Black and Brown communities, and holding businesses accountable for price gouging during disasters.

name: Christopher Hinton
title: Professor
company: Willie A. Deese College of Business and Economics at North Carolina Agricultural and Technical State University

bio: Dr. Christopher A. Hinton is an educator, researcher, and organizational strategist specializing in business strategy, leadership development, and institutional transformation. He serves as a professor at North Carolina A&T State University and is the Founder and Chairman of C. Hinton Consulting Group. His research focuses on Generation Z professionals, intergenerational leadership, and the evolving needs of emerging leaders. Through his work in higher education and consulting, Dr. Hinton advances innovative approaches to organizational effectiveness, business education, and leadership development.

name: Cliff Worley
title: Founder & AI Consultant
brief: Cliff Worley is a top-rated AI keynote speaker and growth advisor who trains Fortune 500 companies on AI adoption and helps them navigate the rapidly changing landscape of artificial intelligence.
bio: Cliff Worley is a top-rated AI keynote speaker and growth advisor who trains Fortune 500 companies on AI adoption and helps them navigate the rapidly changing landscape of artificial intelligence. Drawing on five years in venture capital — where he saw early how AI would reshape how companies compete — Cliff delivers strategic insights on AI implementation and, most importantly, shows teams how to use AI tools to 10x their output. He has advised brands including Amazon, Marriott, Airbnb, Capital One, and Skims, and has worked with Fortune 500 companies representing more than $1 trillion in combined revenue.

name: Cody Coleman
title: Founder and CEO
brief: Dr. Cody Coleman is the Founder and CEO of Coactive AI, an AI infrastructure company helping enterprises search, understand, and activate large-scale content libraries using multimodal AI.
bio: Dr. Cody Coleman is the Founder and CEO of Coactive AI, an AI infrastructure company helping enterprises search, understand, and activate large-scale content libraries using multimodal AI. In addition to his work at Coactive, he serves on the CTA Board of Industry Leaders and the CTA AI Council. He is also a co-creator of DAWNBench and MLPerf, and a founding member of MLCommons. Cody earned his PhD in Computer Science from Stanford University, where he worked closely with Matei Zaharia and Fei-Fei Li, and received his MEng and BS in EECS from MIT. His personal story is featured in the books Grit and Situated by Angela Duckworth.

name: Congresswoman Ayanna Pressley (MA-07)
title: Massachusetts' 7th Congressional District
brief: Congresswoman Ayanna Pressley (MA-07) is an activist, legislator, survivor, and the first woman of color elected to Congress from Massachusetts.
bio: Congresswoman Ayanna Pressley (MA-07) is an activist, legislator, survivor, and the first woman of color elected to Congress from Massachusetts. She has championed the principle that those closest to the pain should be closest to the power, working to inform and shape policymaking. She serves on the House Committees on Financial Services and Oversight and Accountability, where she advocates on issues including reproductive justice, workers’ rights, consumer protections, and support for survivors. Before Congress, she served eight years on the Boston City Council and was the first woman of color elected to the council in its 100-year history.

name: Damario Solomon-Simmons
title: National Civil Rights Attorney, Founder and Chief Legal Counsel, Justice for Greenwood; Author, Redeem a Nation
brief: Damario Solomon-Simmons, Esq., M.Ed., is a National civil rights attorney, Founder and Chief Legal Counsel of Justice for Greenwood, Managing Partner of SolomonSimmonsLaw, and Author of Redeem a…
bio: Damario Solomon-Simmons, Esq., M.Ed., is a National civil rights attorney, Founder and Chief Legal Counsel of Justice for Greenwood, Managing Partner of SolomonSimmonsLaw, and Author of Redeem a Nation (Storehouse Voices/Penguin Random House, 2026). Raised in Tulsa's Greenwood, he has represented the last living survivors of the 1921 Tulsa Race Massacre, won the 2025 ruling restoring citizenship to 100,000+ Black Creek Freedmen, architected Tulsa's $105M Road to Repair, and prompted the DOJ's first investigation of the massacre. He co-executive produced Greenwood Is Still Burning and has been featured on CNN, The View, and GMA.

name: Damien Hooper-Campbell
title: Former Chief Impact Officer
brief: Damien Hooper-Campbell has led impact at the intersection of people, culture, business, and community for 20+ years.
bio: Damien Hooper-Campbell has led impact at the intersection of people, culture, business, and community for 20+ years. He built functions as StockX's first Chief Impact Officer, the first Chief Diversity Officer at both Zoom and eBay, Uber's first Global Head of Diversity & Inclusion, and as a Diversity Strategist at Google. Earlier, he was a VP in Goldman Sachs' Pine Street Leadership Group. He serves on the boards of Mammoth, Inc. and GLAAD, and is a graduate of Morehouse and Harvard Business School.

name: Dani Bauer

brief: Dani leads Developer Communications for ChatGPT and Codex.
bio: Dani leads Developer Communications for ChatGPT and Codex.

bio: Daphne Charles is a Senior Software Engineer with 7+ years building scalable platforms at Salesforce, American Express, and BMW, including products serving 50,000+ daily users. She architects and ships production multi-agent AI systems using Claude API, LangGraph, and MCP. As Global VP of Salesforce Women in Tech, she led technical workshops for a community of 1,000+ members across 5+ countries.

name: Darren Riley
title: CEO + Co-Founder
brief: Darren Riley is the Co-founder and Chief Executive Officer of JustAir, a Detroit-based environmental tech company focused on creating cleaner air and healthier communities.
bio:
Darren Riley is the Co-founder and Chief Executive Officer of JustAir, a Detroit-based environmental tech company focused on creating cleaner air and healthier communities.

After developing asthma in his mid-twenties while living in Southwest Detroit, one of the most polluted areas in the U.S., Riley was inspired to create JustAir. The platform provides actionable air quality data to support health, safety, and environmental regulation, ensuring everyone has access to clean air.

Riley earned a computer science degree from Carnegie Mellon University and has over a decade of experience as a software engineer.

name: Dave Salvant
title: Co-Founder & President
brief: Dave Salvant is Co-Founder & President of SQUIRE, the leading barber business management platform.
bio: Dave Salvant is Co-Founder & President of SQUIRE, the leading barber business management platform. Since 2015, he has helped scale the company into a $750M business, transforming how barbershops operate and serve clients. His work focuses on using technology to empower entrepreneurs and strengthen local communities.

name: Davidek Herron
title: Chief Digital Experience Officer, Genentech
brief: Davidek Herron is the Chief Digital Experience Officer for Genentech, where he works at the intersection of science, technology, and human experience.
bio: Davidek Herron is the Chief Digital Experience Officer for Genentech, where he works at the intersection of science, technology, and human experience. His focus is on making healthcare more connected, understandable, and accessible for patients, families, and communities. Before joining Genentech, Davidekserved as Global Head of Digital at Roche and held leadership roles at Teva Pharmaceuticals. Throughout his career, he has focused on turning innovation—including digital tools, data, and artificial intelligence—into practical experiences that help people access the information, support, and care they need.

name: DeLonzo Rhodes
title: VP, Talent Development, Culture & Belonging
brief: DeLonzo Rhodes is Vice President of Talent Development, Culture & Belonging at People Inc., with extensive experience in HR leadership and workplace transformation.
bio: DeLonzo Rhodes is Vice President of Talent Development, Culture & Belonging at People Inc., with extensive experience in HR leadership and workplace transformation. He has held leadership roles across technology, media, and fashion, aligning talent strategies with business priorities to foster innovation, strengthen performance, and drive growth. An executive coach and facilitator, DeLonzo designs leadership programs that help teams build the capabilities, culture, and experiences needed to navigate change and create lasting organizational impact.

name: Denise Bailey-Castro
title: CFO & COO
brief: Denise Bailey-Castro is Chief Financial Officer & Chief Operating Officer of Westbrook Inc., Will Smith and Jada Pinkett Smith’s independent media company.
bio: Denise Bailey-Castro is Chief Financial Officer & Chief Operating Officer of Westbrook Inc., Will Smith and Jada Pinkett Smith’s independent media company. Her work sits at the intersection of creativity, culture and business, where she leads finance and operations while helping shape content investments, strategic partnerships, and new growth opportunities. Previously, she served as Brand CFO for BET Media Group at Paramount, overseeing a billion-dollar-plus portfolio across linear, streaming, studios, live events and digital. Her career spans media and entertainment, with prior roles at Viacom, HBO, Paramount Pictures and JPMorgan.

name: Denise Young Smith
title: Author
brief: After more than two decades at Apple in executive roles, including the company’s first Black chief of human resources and first VP of inclusion and diversity, Denise Young Smith served as…
bio: After more than two decades at Apple in executive roles, including the company’s first Black chief of human resources and first VP of inclusion and diversity, Denise Young Smith served as executive-in-residence at Cornell Tech. She has been named a “Most Powerful Woman” by Black Enterprise, an Ebony “Power 100,” and one of Business Insider’s “100 Most Influential in Silicon Valley,” and has been featured in Fortune’s “Most Powerful Women” issue. She advises organizations on culture, leadership, and inclusive environments, and is a practicing performing and recording artist.

name: Derrick Johnson
title: President and CEO
brief: Derrick Johnson is the 19th president and CEO of the NAACP, a role he has held since October 2017.
bio: Derrick Johnson is the 19th president and CEO of the NAACP, a role he has held since October 2017. Previously, he served as vice chairman of the National Board of Directors and president of the Mississippi State Conference. Under his leadership, the NAACP launched NAACP Capital and the "We Are Done Dying" campaign exposing healthcare inequities. He helped secure a Biden executive order eliminating systemic racial barriers in federal policy. A seasoned civil rights advocate, he prioritizes closing the wealth gap for Black entrepreneurs and data-driven voter mobilization. Born in Detroit, he earned his JD from South Texas College of Law.

name: Derrick Rainey
title: Mayor
brief: Mayor Derrick Rainey serves as Mayor of Wrightsville, Arkansas, where he champions a vision centered on education, economic development, and community engagement.
bio: Mayor Derrick Rainey serves as Mayor of Wrightsville, Arkansas, where he champions a vision centered on education, economic development, and community engagement. A graduate of Morehouse College and the Clinton School of Public Service, he brings experience in public service, education, entrepreneurship, and small-business development. His leadership emphasizes community participation, strategic growth, and creating opportunities for future generations. Mayor Rainey is committed to ensuring residents have a voice in shaping their city's future and share in the benefits of economic progress.

name: DeShawn Spellman

brief: DeShawn Spellman is a strategic program architect and early talent development leader with more than 15 years of experience designing and scaling programs that prepare college students and…
bio: DeShawn Spellman is a strategic program architect and early talent development leader with more than 15 years of experience designing and scaling programs that prepare college students and early-career professionals for careers in technology, business, and emerging industries. His work sits at the intersection of higher education, workforce development, and industry, where he focuses on career readiness programming and experiential learning opportunities that help students transition successfully from college to career.

name: Desirée Mayon
title: CEO and Founder
brief: Desirée Mayon, Founder of She & HER, is a sapphic Black technologist, data scientist, and senior product leader who has built and scaled human-centered systems across consumer and institutional…
bio:
Desirée Mayon, Founder of She & HER, is a sapphic Black technologist, data scientist, and senior product leader who has built and scaled human-centered systems across consumer and institutional technology.

She has led product and data initiatives at Google, Etsy, Microsoft / Xbox, Nordstrom, and the University of Cambridge. She & HER is built from the lived realities and long-standing gaps she knows intimately. Not hypothesizing needs. Not romanticizing struggle. Just building what's been missing.

name: Devin Jenkins
title: Global Markets Commercial IT Business Partner
brief: Devin Jenkins is a Global Markets Commercial IT Business Partner at GE HealthCare, driving digital innovation at the intersection of healthcare, technology and business strategy.
bio: Devin Jenkins is a Global Markets Commercial IT Business Partner at GE HealthCare, driving digital innovation at the intersection of healthcare, technology and business strategy. With more than 11 years of experience spanning IT, commercial operations and enterprise transformation, he delivers AI-powered solutions that accelerate growth and enhance customer experiences. Beyond GE HealthCare, Devin is the Founder & CEO of Share The Vibes, LLC and host of Share The Vibes Podcast, connecting people through music, media and technology. He supports BDPA and The Harmonie Grace Foundation, advancing dialogue on healthcare, innovation and leadership.

name: Devon Rollins

brief: Devon Rollins is a visionary technologist and dynamic leader, currently serving as the Global Head of Security Response and AI Security at Morgan Stanley.
bio: Devon Rollins is a visionary technologist and dynamic leader, currently serving as the Global Head of Security Response and AI Security at Morgan Stanley. Renowned for pioneering initiatives that accelerate cyber investigations and safeguarding emerging technologies, Devon has led elite cyber intelligence and engineering teams, consistently outsmarting cybercriminals and neutralizing threats to enterprise platforms at petabyte scale.

name: Dr. Alexis Haynes
title: Behavioral Health Scientist
brief: Dr. Alexis Sims Haynes is a behavioral health scientist, public health researcher, educator, and literary creator based in Houston.
bio: Dr. Alexis Sims Haynes is a behavioral health scientist, public health researcher, educator, and literary creator based in Houston. She leads grant development for behavioral health initiatives at Memorial Hermann Health System and teaches public health at Prairie View A&M University. A published scholar with a PhD in Behavioral Sciences and Health Promotion, she is also the founder of Lex With The Text (@lex_withthe_text), a literary platform amplifying Black and BIPOC authors through thoughtful book reviews, author conversations, & powerful storytelling.

name: Dr. Andrew Forde
title: Partner, Head of AI Research
brief: Dr. Andrew Forde is a leader, strategist, and community advocate whose work centers on excellence, equity, and meaningful impact.
bio: Dr. Andrew Forde is a leader, strategist, and community advocate whose work centers on excellence, equity, and meaningful impact. Guided by scholarship, service, and lived experience, he is passionate about leadership, innovation, mentorship, and creating opportunities for emerging talent. Deeply connected to the African and Caribbean diaspora, Dr. Forde views culture as a source of knowledge, creativity, and belonging. A thoughtful communicator, he bridges people and ideas to strengthen communities and inspire progress.

name: Dr. Aparna Ahuja
title: CEO & Founder
brief: Aparna Ahuja, MD, is a physician executive and global leader in Medical, Clinical, and Scientific Affairs.
bio: Aparna Ahuja, MD, is a physician executive and global leader in Medical, Clinical, and Scientific Affairs. With leadership roles at Abbott, BD, and T2 Biosystems, she has advanced innovation across diagnostics, medical devices, and clinical sciences. She specializes in evidence generation, regulatory strategy, and global product launches, with a focus on equitable healthcare, patient advocacy, and improving health outcomes through science and innovation.

name: Dr. Brandi K. Freeman
title: President
brief: Dr. Brandi Kaye Freeman is the 127th President of the National Medical Association (NMA), the nation’s oldest and largest organization representing African American physicians and their patients.
bio: Dr. Brandi Kaye Freeman is the 127th President of the National Medical Association (NMA), the nation’s oldest and largest organization representing African American physicians and their patients. Dr. Freeman is a practicing pediatrician, Associate Professor and the Vice Chair of Health Opportunities and Professional Engagement (HOPE) for the Department of Pediatrics at the University of Colorado School of Medicine. Her research portfolio includes developing approaches to improve Equity in Healthcare and best practices to help children thrive in early childhood.

name: Dr. Charles DeShazer

bio: Dr. Charles DeShazer is a nationally recognized physician executive and Managing Partner of Nuvanta Consulting Group, advising healthcare and life sciences leaders on AI strategy and governance. A former C-suite leader at Cigna, Google Health, and Highmark, he integrates data, digital infrastructure, and AI to advance quality, value-based care, and health equity across complex health systems.

name: Dr. Charles R. Rogers
title: Founder & Chief Advisor, Rogers Solutions Group; Founder & President, Colorectal Cancer Equity Foundation
brief: Charles R. Rogers, PhD, MPH, MS, MCHES® is a behavioral scientist, executive advisor, and health equity strategist with 20+ years of experience connecting evidence, people, and strategy to drive…
bio: Charles R. Rogers, PhD, MPH, MS, MCHES® is a behavioral scientist, executive advisor, and health equity strategist with 20+ years of experience connecting evidence, people, and strategy to drive measurable impact. As Founder & Chief Advisor of Rogers Solutions Group and Founder & President of the Colorectal Cancer Equity Foundation, he advances healthcare innovation, cancer prevention, and community engagement. His leadership helped reach 44,000+ people, facilitate 1,600+ colorectal cancer screenings, & grow community partnerships by 200%. His work bridges research, trust, & organizational change to turn promising ideas into lasting results.

name: Dr. Chemen Neal MD, CPCC, FACOG
title: Vice President Academic Medicine & Strategic Integration, Associate Professor OBGYN
company: IU Health Medical Group & IU School of Medicine
brief: Chemen M. Neal, MD, CPCC is a physician–executive, educator, and leader in organizational culture, academic medicine, and strategic integration across complex health systems.
bio: Chemen M. Neal, MD, CPCC is a physician–executive, educator, and leader in organizational culture, academic medicine, and strategic integration across complex health systems. She serves as Vice President of Academic Medicine and Strategic Integration for IU Health Medical Group, Indiana’s largest multi-specialty medical group. In this role, she advances physician pipeline and workforce efforts, strengthens alignment across 16 hospitals and 300 clinical sites, and leads enterprise initiatives that support the evolving needs of Indiana’s largest healthcare system.

name: Dr. Cheryl Polote Williamson
title: Editor-in-Chief
brief: Dr. Cheryl Polote-Williamson is a global media executive, speaker, and author of 19 best-selling titles.
bio: Dr. Cheryl Polote-Williamson is a global media executive, speaker, and author of 19 best-selling titles. She is Editor-in-Chief of Cheryl Magazine, host of the NAACP Image Award-nominated podcast Ageless, Fearless & Unscripted, and an executive producer of Twenty Pearls. An Advisor to the Ghana Tourism Federation and Global Ambassador for She Empowerment Global, she has received the T.D. Jakes Foundation Champion of Change Award and a Presidential Lifetime Achievement Award, and has spoken at Essence, Black Enterprise, and the National Urban League.

name: Dr. Chris Pernell
title: Health Equity Director
brief: Dr. Chris T. Pernell is a physician leader, public health advocate, and Director of the NAACP Center for Health Equity. Her work focuses on health justice, community advocacy, and population health.
bio: Dr. Chris T. Pernell is a physician leader, public health advocate, and Director of the NAACP Center for Health Equity. Her work focuses on health justice, community advocacy, and population health. Before joining the NAACP, she founded The Esther Group, a public health consulting firm, and served as the first Chief Strategic Integration and Health Equity Officer at University Hospital in Newark. Dr. Pernell earned her degree from Princeton University, her M.D. from Duke University, and her M.P.H. from Columbia University. She is also a Clinical Assistant Professor at Rutgers New Jersey Medical School.

name: Dr. Christine Izuakor
title: Founder and CEO
brief: Dr. Christine Izuakor is a global tech leader and speaker dedicated to helping professionals connect, learn, and grow through curated, AI-matched experiences and conversations.
bio: Dr. Christine Izuakor is a global tech leader and speaker dedicated to helping professionals connect, learn, and grow through curated, AI-matched experiences and conversations. She has over a decade of Fortune 100 cybersecurity experience and earned a Ph.D. in Security Engineering, becoming the youngest student and first African American to do so. Christine holds leading certifications like CISSP and CISM and is a seasoned cybersecurity professor. Her work has been presented globally, from Italy to South Korea, including features in Crain’s, The Wall Street Journal, Forbes, and more.

name: Dr. Dineo Khabele
title: Mitchell & Elaine Yanow Professor and Chair, Department of Obstetrics and Gynecology
brief: Dr. Dineo Khabele is a physician-scientist and leader in obstetrics & gynecology (OBGYN) and women's health.
bio: Dr. Dineo Khabele is a physician-scientist and leader in obstetrics & gynecology (OBGYN) and women's health. She is recognized for her clinical expertise in gynecologic oncology and for her research focused on improving the treatment of ovarian cancer. As a leader in academic medicine, Dr. Khabele is committed to driving institutional change, training the next generation, and advancing OBGYN and women's health care for all.

name: Dr. Félix Manuel Chinea
title: Senior Director, Health Equity
brief: Dr. Félix Manuel Chinea is a physician and strategist working at the intersection of health equity, responsible AI, and innovation.
bio: Dr. Félix Manuel Chinea is a physician and strategist working at the intersection of health equity, responsible AI, and innovation. As Head of Health Equity at Doximity, he ensures digital health tools are designed with an equitable lens for a diverse medical network. A Duke University School of Medicine graduate and 2022 Aspen Institute Health Fellow, he has been named to the Fierce 50 in Health Equity and Rock Health's Top 50 in Digital Health. He lives in Durham, NC.

name: Dr. Jessica Shepherd
title: Chief Medical Officer
brief: Dr. Jessica Shepherd is Chief Medical Officer at Hers.
bio: Dr. Jessica Shepherd is Chief Medical Officer at Hers. A board-certified OB/GYN with nearly twenty years of clinical experience in obstetrics, gynecology, and surgery, Dr. Shepherd is a women's health, sexual wellness, and menopausal expert, the founder of Sanctum Med and Wellness, and the author of Generation M: Living Well in Perimenopause and Menopause. As Hers' first-ever Chief Medical Officer, Dr. Shepherd guides the clinical expertise that forms the foundation of the Hers brand across perimenopause and menopause, sexual health, dermatology, weight loss, and mental health.

name: Dr. Kevin B. Johnson MD, MS
title: David L. Cohen University Professor of Pediatrics, Biomedical Informatics, and Communication
brief: Kevin B. Johnson, MD, MS, is Penn’s David L. Cohen University Professor and Vice President of Applied Clinical Informatics.
bio: Kevin B. Johnson, MD, MS, is Penn’s David L. Cohen University Professor and Vice President of Applied Clinical Informatics. A pediatrician, computer scientist, and internationally recognized informatics leader, his work focuses on AI and clinical documentation. He has authored 200+ publications, co-created the Who, Me? STEMM book series, and was elected to the National Academy of Medicine. His forthcoming memoir, MisFit: Notes on Belonging, Brilliance, and the Spaces Between, traces a Black physician-scientist’s journey from otherness and compartmentalization toward belonging, wholeness, and authentic leadership.

name: Dr. Krystal Redman
title: Executive Director; Founder & CEO; Adjunct Professor
company: SPARK RJ NOW, inc.; SEJH Institute; Emory Rollins School of Public Health
brief: Dr. Krystal Redman, DrPH, MHA, is a public health leader, TEDx Speaker, strategist, author, and community builder working at the intersection of reproductive justice, Health Justice, public health…
bio: Dr. Krystal Redman, DrPH, MHA, is a public health leader, TEDx Speaker, strategist, author, and community builder working at the intersection of reproductive justice, Health Justice, public health, and liberation. They serve as Executive Director of SPARK Reproductive Justice NOW!, Founder & CEO of the S.E.J.H. Institute, Adjunct Faculty at Emory University’s Rollins School of Public Health, and Creator & Host of OurPanel TV. A 2025 40 Under 40 Black Health Leader and Public Health Catalyst Award recipient, Dr. Redman builds health systems rooted in justice, equity, bodily autonomy, and community power.

name: Dr. Lauire Hamilton
title: Educator, Scholar & Keynote Speaker
brief: Dr. Laurie Diane Hamilton is an educator, scholar, keynote speaker, and dynamic moderator with nearly two decades of experience in education, leadership, and advocacy.
bio: Dr. Laurie Diane Hamilton is an educator, scholar, keynote speaker, and dynamic moderator with nearly two decades of experience in education, leadership, and advocacy. She holds a doctorate in Instructional Leadership from St. John’s University, where her research explored equity and representation in gifted education. A passionate lover of literature and storytelling, Dr. Hamilton brings intellectual curiosity, warmth, and engaging dialogue to conversations with authors and thought leaders. Her work centers on amplifying diverse voices, inspiring meaningful discourse, and celebrating the transformative power of stories.

name: Dr. Louis Carr
title: President
brief: Louis is the President of BET a role he assumed in December 2025 after nearly four decades of transformative leadership within the company.
bio: Louis is the President of BET a role he assumed in December 2025 after nearly four decades of transformative leadership within the company. Across his 39 year tenure, He has helped shape BET into the premier media destination for Black audiences worldwide, driving culture, impact, and community empowerment at every step. Before becoming President, Carr served as President of Media Sales, where he redefined the multicultural space for some of the world's biggest brands and stimulated over $10B in advertising sales through strategic partnerships with corporations like Procter & Gamble, Walmart, Unilever, McDonald's, Meta, Toyota, and many more.

name: Dr. Nicol Turner Lee
title: Director, Center for Technology Innovation (CTI) and Senior Fellow, Governance Studies
brief: Dr. Nicol Turner Lee is a senior fellow in Governance Studies and Director of the Center for Technology Innovation at the Brookings Institution.
bio: Dr. Nicol Turner Lee is a senior fellow in Governance Studies and Director of the Center for Technology Innovation at the Brookings Institution. She founded the AI Equity Lab to craft inclusive AI policy. Her research spans equitable tech access and AI bias mitigation. She authored "Digitally Invisible" (2024) and has testified before Congress and global bodies, served on NASEM, CFTC, and FCC advisory panels, and earned honors from ASA, Alliance for Women in Media, and Rainbow PUSH. Named a 2025–2026 Washingtonian Tech Titan and Ebony Power 100 STEM Trailblazer. She holds a B.A. from Colgate and a Ph.D. from Northwestern.

name: Dr. Nicole Murray
title: Chief Neuropsychologist
company: Durham Region Center for Cognitive Health
brief: Dr. Murray is a neuropsychologist specializing in executive cognition, decision-making, and performance under pressure.
bio: Dr. Murray is a neuropsychologist specializing in executive cognition, decision-making, and performance under pressure. She works with high-performing professionals and leaders to assess and optimize cognitive function in high-stakes environments, including those navigating complex roles and cognitive demands. Her work sits at the intersection of neuroscience and performance, translating brain science into strategic advantage.

name: Dr. Shannon Barnes Martin
title: Principal Nurse Experience Manager
brief: Dr. Shannon Barnes Martin is a nurse informaticist and healthcare technology leader with over 20 years of nursing experience across pediatrics, nephrology, medical-surgical care, and more.
bio: Dr. Shannon Barnes Martin is a nurse informaticist and healthcare technology leader with over 20 years of nursing experience across pediatrics, nephrology, medical-surgical care, and more. She currently serves as Principal Nurse Experience Manager at Microsoft, leading nursing initiatives and generative AI adoption in healthcare. Dr. Martin is also dedicated to community outreach through organizations including Girls Who Code and the Birmingham Civil Rights Institute.

name: Dr. Sharon Malone
title: Author & Chief Medical Advisor, Alloy
brief: Sharon Malone, M.D., is a board-certified OB/GYN and a certified menopause practitioner who has practiced medicine in the nation’s capital for more than thirty years.
bio: Sharon Malone, M.D., is a board-certified OB/GYN and a certified menopause practitioner who has practiced medicine in the nation’s capital for more than thirty years. She is the chief medical advisor of Alloy Women’s Health and a passionate advocate for improved research and education around women’s health in midlife. She lives in Washington, D.C., with her husband, Eric Holder.

name: Dr. Tamiko Foster
title: CEO & Founder
brief: Tamiko Foster, MD, MPH, is a physician executive, National Medical Director, and CEO & Founder of 2 E.D.I.F.Y., LLC, a lifestyle medicine and wellness company.
bio: Tamiko Foster, MD, MPH, is a physician executive, National Medical Director, and CEO & Founder of 2 E.D.I.F.Y., LLC, a lifestyle medicine and wellness company. A former Chief Medical Officer and Health Policy Fellow, she works at the intersection of population health, health policy, and lifestyle medicine, applying community‑centered innovation in service of people. Her work advances whole‑person care models that advance health equity, optimize utilization, and improve outcomes at scale.

name: Dr. Tiffani Bright
title: Co-Director, Center for Artificial Intelligence Research and Education Assistant Professor of Computational Biomedicine, Cedars-Sinai Medical Center
brief: Tiffani J. Bright, PhD, FACMI, is an Assistant Professor in Cedars-Sinai's Department of Computational Biomedicine and Co-Director of the Center for AI Research & Education.
bio: Tiffani J. Bright, PhD, FACMI, is an Assistant Professor in Cedars-Sinai's Department of Computational Biomedicine and Co-Director of the Center for AI Research & Education. Her work advances trustworthy, ethical AI in healthcare by developing and evaluating models and methods that detect and mitigate bias in machine learning. A member of the Kiskiack Nation, she is recognized as the first Black woman in the United States to earn a PhD in Biomedical Informatics and the first from Columbia University to do so. She is a Fellow of ACMI.

name: Dr. Timnit Gebru
title: Founder & Executive Director
company: Distributed Artificial Intelligence Research Institute – DAIR
brief: Timnit is the author of the forthcoming book, Deep Unlearning, a memoir + manifesto arguing for a technological future that serves our communities instead of one that is used for surveillance…
bio: Timnit is the author of the forthcoming book, Deep Unlearning, a memoir + manifesto arguing for a technological future that serves our communities instead of one that is used for surveillance, warfare, and the centralization of power by Silicon Valley. She is also the founder and Executive Director of The Distributed Artificial Intelligence Research (DAIR) Institute, which performs community-rooted AI research that imagines a technological future supporting the needs of marginalized communities. Timnit has appeared in notable lists including TIME’s 100 influential people, and Nature’s 10 influential people within the world of science.

name: Dr. Uché Blackstock
title: Founder & CEO, Advancing Health Equity; Author, Legacy: A Black Physician Reckons with Racism in Medicine, New York Times Bestseller
brief: Dr. Uché Blackstock is a physician, health care systems architect, and Founder and CEO of Advancing Health Equity, where she partners with organizations to redesign how care is delivered, led, and…
bio: Dr. Uché Blackstock is a physician, health care systems architect, and Founder and CEO of Advancing Health Equity, where she partners with organizations to redesign how care is delivered, led, and experienced. A Harvard Medical School graduate and board-certified emergency physician, she is recognized for advancing health care quality, accountability, and systems change. She is also the New York Times bestselling author of Legacy: A Black Physician Reckons with Racism in Medicine. Through her consulting, writing, and media work, Dr. Blackstock calls for equity to be treated as a measurable performance standard, not merely an ideal.

name: Dr. Vindell Washington
title: Chief Clinical Officer
brief: Vindell Washington, MD, MS, is the Chief Clinical Officer and Head of Health Equity Center of Excellence at Verily.
bio: Vindell Washington, MD, MS, is the Chief Clinical Officer and Head of Health Equity Center of Excellence at Verily. bio: Kasheef Wyzard is the National Director of Economic Opportunity at Dream.Org, leading initiatives that advance workforce development, entrepreneurship, and an inclusive green economy. His work has reached over 1,000 participants, deployed $2M in scholarships, invested $1.3M in underrepresented founders, and mobilized $5.3M in catalytic capital. A Georgia State University graduate and member of Kappa Alpha Psi Fraternity, Inc., Kasheef believes those closest to the problem must help lead the solutions.

name: Keena Grigsby

bio: Keena is Chief Marketing Officer & Vice President, U.S. Mobile Experience (MX) at Samsung Electronics America. She leads marketing and communications for Samsung’s mobile portfolio including Galaxy smartphones, wearables, tablets, PCs and the connected ecosystem. She is a seasoned global marketing leader with nearly 20 years of experience leading talented marketing teams at Microsoft, Apple, and Verizon. Recently, Keena served as General Manager and Global Head of Windows Marketing at Microsoft, where she led the go-to-market strategy, campaigns, integrated marketing, communications, and operations for the consumer & commercial segments.

name: Keith Azodeh

bio: Keith Azodeh is an IT Director and Principal AI Consultant with a background in software engineering, enterprise sales, and technical leadership. He builds practical systems that replace third-party subscriptions for founders and small businesses. He created AfroTech.guide, including an MCP integration for ChatGPT and Claude. He is also the creator of Exempliph.ai, a free tool for job seekers, and leads a 5,000-member tech community.

bio: Kelly Buchanan Spillers is VP of Brand and Product Marketing at Rocket. She has 20+ years leading brand, digital, and product marketing across B2C and B2B. Previously VP of Global Digital & Social Marketing at CeraVe, she shaped the brand's voice across 40+ markets, earning Cannes Lions recognition, and served as CMO at Infor, with senior roles at L'Oréal USA, Digitas, Ogilvy, and Accenture Interactive. Kelly holds an MBA from NYU Stern, is an adjunct professor of Business Ethics at NYU Stern, and lives in Brooklyn, New York.

name: Kenneth Walsh

bio: Kenneth Walsh is a Senior AI Acceleration Architect based in New York who has worked at AWS for over 9 years across a range of roles and services. He helps accelerate AWS builder productivity with generative AI automation tools, and as a trusted advisor he guides customers through their generative AI journeys with both technical expertise and genuine passion. Outside of AI, Kenneth enjoys crafting culinary creations, audiobooks, and quality time with his family.

name: Kevin Simmonds

bio: Kevin is an Atlanta-based Principal in the PwC US Cyber, Data & Tech Risk (CDTR) practice. He has over 20 years of experience assisting companies with developing business-aligned Information Security programs, developing sustainable Payment Card Industry (PCI) programs, executing technical security assessments, and recovering from cyber incidents. Kevin also provides oversight for PwC’s Cyber Penetration Testing Team (CPT2), comprised of advanced practitioners focused on adversary attack simulation services (e.g., red teaming, purple teaming, application security testing, and more) for clients across industries.

name: Kevin Williams

bio: A senior leader with over two decades of experience helping organizations drive growth, strengthen brands and create meaningful experiences with measurable impact. As Vice President of Digital Strategy & Experience at Planned Parenthood Federation of America he leads digital strategy, innovation and experience initiatives that expand access to healthcare, education, advocacy, and support while strengthening organizational performance and engagement. Known for his collaborative cross-functional leadership, Kevin brings together diverse teams and partners to solve complex challenges, align strategy with execution and build scalable solutions.

name: King Willonius
title: AI Story-teller, Filmmaker, Comedian
brief: Willonius “King Willonius” Hatcher is a comedian, author, futurist, and creative technologist redefining what entertainment and innovation look like in the age of artificial intelligence.
bio:
Willonius “King Willonius” Hatcher is a comedian, author, futurist, and creative technologist redefining what entertainment and innovation look like in the age of artificial intelligence.

Hatcher was named one of TIME’s 100 Most Influential People in AI, a 2025 Ebony Power 100 honoree, and a member of Ad Age’s 2025 Power Tech List. His viral AI hit “BBL DRIZZY” became one of the most influential creative works of the decade, generating millions of remixes, a response from Drake, and igniting global conversations around AI, authorship, and Black creativity. He's shared insights at SXSW, TEDx, MIT, Harvard, Bridge Summit, and The Next Web.

name: Kirk Barnes

bio: Kirk Barnes is the founder of the TransPharMed Commercialization Lab and the world's first Digital Health Sales Institute—building the commercial infrastructure and workforce pipeline the digital health industry needs to scale. A former biopharma executive, Georgia Tech innovator, and global ecosystem builder, Kirk has coached hundreds of founders and thousands of sales professionals across four continents.

name: Kobie Fuller

bio: Kobie has been a General Partner at Upfront since 2016, where he focuses on applied AI and next generation human computer interaction platforms. Over more than two decades in venture capital, he has held key roles at Accel, OpenView Venture Partners, and Insight Venture Partners, backing category-defining companies including ExactTarget (acquired by Salesforce for $2.5B), UserTesting (IPO and $1.3B exit), and Oculus (acquired by Meta for $2B). At Upfront, his current investments include Sandbar, Laurel, Cordial, Martie and a growing set of companies shaping the future of AI-enabled work.

name: Kofo Akosile
title: Financial Planner

bio: Kofo Akosile, CFP®, ChFC®, is a financial planner with Prudential Wealth Advisors and the founder of DreamMaker Financial. With more than a decade of experience helping professionals and families make confident financial decisions, she is passionate about empowering others, especially first-generation wealth builders, to break financial cycles and create lasting wealth. Her greatest fulfillment comes from making financial advice accessible and relatable so that anyone, regardless of their background, can take charge of their financial future with confidence.

name: Korri Jackson

bio: Korri Jackson, a Senior Program Manager on Apple’s Environment, Policy, and Social Initiatives Team, develops and implements strategies that shape Apple’s global impact on education across K-12, higher education, and workforce development. With over 25 years of experience in technology education, Korri has championed Apple’s commitment to education as a core value since joining the company in 2015. Her career at Apple began with developing education content and launching programs for Worldwide Education Product Marketing. In 2020, she transitioned to leading and supporting community-based education projects and programs for the company.

name: Kossi Houngbedji
